content.p_01: I'm ramency. I'm known under different names too, I mainly use this one for my privacy though. Until recently I've been in an apprenticeship for software development at a rehabilitation facility.
content.p_02: In the past I was able to gather quite a bit of experience already, for example in web development, game development, emulation and a tiny bit in embedded systems. That got me into contact with many different programming languages and frameworks. A couple examples are Rust, C, C#, Java, Kotlin, PHP, React, Vite, TypeScript and more. Further information in section "Projects".

web.title: Web development
web.description: The Better Place Community Wiki. Created by the wishes of the founder of Bplace, a site where you can draw pixels on the world map. Runs on Mediawiki in Docker containers, routing via Caddy, firewall, ports, security updates; all set up and configured on my own. Additionally, this website, as well as two older variants (one made purely with TypeScript and Vite, the other only with JavaScript.

rust.title: Rust
rust.description: Interested in Rust because of its unique memory management (borrowing, referencing etc.). Also interesting to me because of its high speed compared to languages like Python. First experiences made by starting to develop a GameBoy Emulator. See link. Siehe Link.

actionscript.title: ActionScript
actionscript.description: Developed a UI Skin for a Skyrim Mod. In part made with ActionScript (Shockwave Flash).

java_kotlin.title: Java, Kotlin
java_kotlin.description: Java was my first programming language. I like to play Minecraft making me experiment with mods at a young age. In addition the programming language I learnt in vocational school during my apprenticeship at MIFCOM. I wrote a practice mod as well as a small functional mod in Java for Minecraft. In Kotlin I made a "Terminal-Coffeemaker" with thorough documentation (German Project). See link.

csharp.title: C#
csharp.description: Initial experience gathered with Unity, made a test game by following a tutorial, expanded it with my own ideas after. See link.

c.title: C
c.description: Used for my project at the rehabilitation facility in Abensberg. The goal was to develop an employee time tracking system. The planned components were an ESP32, NFC chips and readers, etc. The ESP32 was supposed to be programmed via ESP-IDF in C.
